divisions.name: Civic Integrity Division
divisions.description: Governs procedural fairness, transparency, and accountability in municipal decision-making. Ensures all governance actions align with constitutional principles and due process.

divisions.name: Fiscal Stewardship Division
divisions.description: Oversees municipal budget allocation, spending restrictions, and financial transparency. Ensures funds are used for their intended purposes and public benefit.

divisions.name: Transparency & Audit Division
divisions.description: Maintains records of all municipal governance actions, voting patterns, and executive decisions. Enables public audit trails and forensic investigation.

divisions.name: Legal Compliance Division
divisions.description: Enforces adherence to federal, state, and local law. Blocks governance actions that violate statutes, ordinances, or constitutional constraints.

divisions.name: Executive Oversight Division
divisions.description: Monitors municipal executive actions, enforcement authority, and administrative power. Ensures checks and balances on executive discretion.

divisions.name: Public Safety Division
divisions.description: Ensures municipal governance protects public welfare, minimizes harm, and maintains civil order. Governs emergency response and community safety protocols.

divisions.name: Stakeholder Representation Division
divisions.description: Ensures that municipal governance decisions incorporate input from affected constituencies. Validates that deliberative processes include diverse stakeholder voices.

divisions.name: Remedial Justice Division
divisions.description: Manages corrective action, liability assessment, and remedy provision when municipal governance failures cause harm. Enforces accountability and restitution.
